note: Photographic openings for surfaces that are not destination chapters. Same shape as the `hero` block in data/destinations.json so the owner changes one photo ID and re-runs `npm run images:heroes`. `surface` matches the key the page asks for.

archive.note: A field of moving water, edge to edge. Chosen after rendering: photo-0183 is the same water with two watching figures, and it was the first pick, but a 72svh band either crops the figures out entirely (making the reason for choosing it disappear) or blows them up until the title sits on someone's head. This frame is the composition the band actually shows, so the hero and the photograph agree. It names no place, holds vast negative space for the title, and repeats neither a chapter hero nor the Home opening.

encode.reason: Dense water texture with no saturated fine colour detail; 4:2:0 is invisible here and roughly halves the file.

journey-malaysia.note: A covered walkway between heavy columns, sea on both sides, one small figure at the far end. Chosen over the Malaysia destination hero (photo-0060, the skyline) and over photo-0036 (storm light on a beach, which is already the Home opening and would spend the island in the first frame). The story opens on return and crossing rather than on arrival in a country, and this is the only frame in the set that is about movement without claiming a place. The bottom scrim is heavier and starts higher than a chapter hero's because this hero carries a standfirst as well as a title.

black-and-white-archive.note: A raised hand against the sun over the sea. A true monochrome frame from the Phase 7 black-and-white edit, graphic enough to carry a full viewport, and deliberately not another seascape — the curated Black & White page already opens on a breakwater.

journey-thailand.note: A gold-lit cloud standing over a pagoda spire in scaffolding, 13 October 2024 — his first week back. Chosen over photo-0680 (the karst bay, already the Thailand chapter hero) and over every beach in the set, because this story is about a changed opinion rather than a good holiday: the scaffolding keeps it honest, and the light is real rather than graded. The top veil is lighter than usual because the frame is already dark at the top.

journey-laos.note: The established Laos hero: two monks walking past a black vintage Mercedes in late light. Story 03 reuses it because the frame introduces precisely the chapter's subject — Buddhist street life becoming ordinary observation — and the trusted Laos pool contains no equally strong alternative. The Phase 9.30A 50% focal correction is preserved so neither monk is cropped at the head and the Mercedes remains legible.
